entrypoints.summary: Client-side TripleDH processing verifies the server transcript MAC carried in a ke2 message.
Server-side TripleDH processing verifies the client transcript MAC carried in a ke3 message.

affected_components.role: Receives and verifies server and client TripleDH transcript MACs.

code_slices.fixed: Commit 3c4b7ce changes both checks to HMAC verify calls, including client_mac.verify(&ke3_message.mac).is_err().
code_slices.surrounding_context: The comparisons occur in TripleDH key-exchange processing after updating an HMAC with the relevant transcript hash.
code_slices.vulnerable: The audited v0.5.0 implementation directly compared the received ke2 and ke3 MAC values against finalized expected HMAC bytes.

negative_controls: No supplied timing trace demonstrates distinguishability.
No supplied execution artifact demonstrates tag recovery or successful forged-transcript acceptance.
observability.positive_marker: A timing difference correlated with MAC comparison behavior; successful forgery would result in transcript acceptance.

preconditions: The attacker can participate in or supply messages to an OPAQUE 3DH exchange.
The attacker can obtain repeated, sufficiently precise observations of transcript-MAC verification timing.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A 3DH exchange message containing a candidate transcript MAC value.
trigger_steps.summary: Submit or cause processing of a ke2 or ke3 message whose transcript MAC is chosen by the attacker, then observe the verification timing.

impacts.concept: acceptance of a forged TripleDH transcript

relation_candidates.rationale: Received ke2 and ke3 MAC values reach the transcript-MAC comparison sites; direct comparison can yield data-dependent timing.
The audit describes forgery as contingent on an attacker being able to precisely measure comparison timing.

relation_candidates.dst: acceptance of a forged TripleDH transcript
relation_candidates.rationale: The stated consequence is passing transcript verification for a false 3DH transcript.
The remediation replaces both direct comparisons with HMAC verify calls and the audit identifies this change as constant-time MAC verification.

impact.affected_asset: Integrity and authentication of OPAQUE TripleDH transcript/session establishment
impact.attacker_capability: If repeated precise verification timings are obtainable, potentially construct a forged 3DH transcript MAC that passes verification
impact.security_effect: Conditional authentication-tag forgery through a transcript-MAC timing side channel

causal_trace.summary: A party participating in an OPAQUE 3DH exchange can cause transcript MAC values in ke2 or ke3 exchange messages to be checked by the endpoint.

The reviewed v0.5.0 logic used direct equality for received MAC bytes versus the finalized expected HMAC at both transcript-verification sites, rather than constant-time authentication-tag verification.
Data-dependent MAC comparison can expose a timing side channel during transcript-hash verification when an attacker can obtain repeated precise timing observations.

Under that precise-timing condition, timing differences may permit incremental recovery or forgery of a transcript MAC so that a false 3DH transcript is accepted, authenticating an attacker-controlled exchange or session.

failure.operation: Direct equality comparison of received ke2/ke3 transcript MAC bytes against finalized HMAC output

primary_invariant.statement: Verification of received TripleDH transcript MACs must not have runtime dependent on whether or where attacker-supplied MAC bytes differ from the expected HMAC.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Both ke2 and ke3 verification sites directly compared received MAC values with finalized HMAC byte arrays; the audit identifies these comparisons as non-constant-time, and the remediation replaces them with HMAC verification.

quality.review_notes: The audit and two-line remediation establish the mechanism and fix at two symmetric MAC-verification sites. The supplied artifacts contain no timing measurements, executable proof of concept, or execution result; practical forgery remains conditional on repeated precise timing observations. The raw vulnerable-code HTML excerpts did not yield focused source lines, but the report-to-patch linkage and inspected patch diff support the pre-fix direct-comparison claim.

remediation.invariant_restored: Both transcript-MAC checks use HMAC's verify operation instead of direct byte-array equality, so authentication-tag acceptance is delegated to the constant-time verification primitive.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: opaque-ke v1.2.0 (audit reports the fix was applied)
